evidence.excerpt: Puzović is available for new collaborations from autumn 2026 onwards; she is currently finishing supervision commitments tied to the MONOBAR project. She prefers partnerships where experimental work is conducted at the Faculty of Technology laboratory rather than entirely on-site at partner premises, given equipment specificity. She has expressed interest in pharmaceutical and medical device packaging applications as an expansion direction.
